## 分诊定级 · 首次定级 · `bug` · **p1** · `domain:engine` · `pm:queue`

⚠️ 同上:此前只带 `pm:retriage`,标签误用,本轮定级与摘标一次写完。

### 域锚定

`packages/formula` 属 engine 车道(`references/lanes/engine.md:8`)⇒ `domain:engine`。

### p1 —— 而理由**正是它与 #13495 的差别**

本轮同批定级的 #13495 也是放宽方向,本席判了 p2,因为那一面不是用户可观察面。**这一张够得到**:

> `compileCelToFilter` 是 ADR-0058 D1/D2/D6 的**规范 CEL 下推**,消费方是 `plugin-security/rls-compiler.ts` 与 `plugin-sharing`。

⇒ **活体 RLS 路径**。一个 null 成员被逐字放进 RLS filter,而同一模块对 null **标量**变量是 fail-closed 且有 pin —— 不对称落在真实的读作用域上。⭐ 卡自带正对照(clean list 编译成普通 `$in`,证明 harness 确实走到了 lowering),合格。

### ⚠️ 不挂 `pm:blocked`,尽管正文写了 `Blocked-by: #13357`

卡自己把两半分开了,分诊**同意这个切分**:

- **可派的一半** —— null MEMBER 不走 fail-closed 而 null SCALAR 走,这条**不对称本身**不需要知道 `$in [null]` 应当选什么:fail-closed 的含义就是**拒绝编译**,与 #13357 在另一层要裁的问题不冲突。
- **被阻的一半** —— 该 filter 究竟应当选出哪些行,等 #13357。

### ⛔ 边界(本席上一轮刚吃过这个亏)

R+53 的 #13166 是一张**自相矛盾的派发单**:边界禁止触某个目录,而其中一道围栏只可能落在那里。⇒ 本单把边界写成可执行的:

> 执行者**不得**在本单内决定 `$in [null]` 的行集语义。若修法必须依赖那个语义才能落地 ⇒ **回分诊升 `pm:blocked`**,⛔ 不要自行拍板,也不要为了绕开而把 fail-closed 做成半个。

## Claimed — dispatch R9, claim A

- **Seat / session**: `domain:engine` lane PM · `session_01F3jdziLbAPGeceVNmSox5L`
- **Branch**: `claude/issue-13496-membership-null-member`
- **Worktree**: `../objectstack-13496-cel-null-member` (per-task, off `origin/main`)
- **File surface**: `packages/formula/src/cel-to-filter.ts` + its test siblings. Consumers (`plugin-security/rls-compiler.ts`, `plugin-sharing`) are **read-only** for this claim unless a measurement forces otherwise, in which case report before editing.
- **Clause ② (contract review)**: **FIRES**, on the content limb. No `packages/spec/src/**` path is touched, but this changes what a security pushdown *emits or refuses* for an input it currently accepts — that is contract accept/reject behaviour at a permission boundary. Review at `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` before the PR is flipped ready.

### Scope — the fail-closed half ONLY

This card is explicitly severable and says so itself:

> Blocked-by: #13357 — what this filter SHOULD select is the ruling that card is waiting for. The fail-closed asymmetry below is independent of that ruling; the row-set consequence is not.

**In scope**: the asymmetry in `lowerMembership` — a null MEMBER of a resolved membership array is passed through verbatim while a null SCALAR variable takes the `unresolved-variable` fail-closed path, against the module's own stated discipline.

**⛔ Out of scope**: making the backends agree on what `{owner: {$in: [null]}}` selects. That is #13357's ruling and it is with the maintainer. Do not touch `memory-matcher.ts`, `driver-sql`, or `driver-sqlite-wasm` — and note that claim B of this same round holds a lock on `memory-matcher.ts`.

**⛔ Also out of scope**: the empty-list case. `$in: []` is already ruled a legitimate declared predicate by `packages/lint/src/validate-empty-combinators.ts` and was measured consistent across all faces. It is the neighbouring shape, not a defect.

Full dispatch order follows in the next comment.

## Dispatch order — R9 claim A (#13496, fail-closed half)

Three zones. **Zone 1 is not re-adjudicable. Zone 2 is the PM's mechanism assumption and you are asked to try to falsify it — a measured refutation is a better outcome than a confirmation. Zone 3 is a suggestion you may discard without asking.**

---

### Zone 1 — RULINGS

**R1. The fail-closed asymmetry only.** In scope: `lowerMembership` passes a null MEMBER of a resolved membership array through verbatim, while a null SCALAR variable takes the `unresolved-variable` path, against the module's own docblock. Out of scope: what `{owner: {$in: [null]}}` *selects* on each backend. That is #13357, it is `needs-user-decision`, and it is with the maintainer.

**R2. ⛔ Do not touch `packages/drivers/driver-memory/src/memory-matcher.ts`.** Claim B of this same round holds a lock on that file for #13494/#13495/#13549. Nor `driver-sql` or `driver-sqlite-wasm`. If your work appears to require any of them, that is a signal you have crossed into R1's out-of-scope half — STOP and report.

**R3. The empty-list case is already ruled and is not a defect.** `packages/lint/src/validate-empty-combinators.ts` calls `$in: []` "a legitimate, declared predicate — matches nothing on every backend", and this card measured it consistent across all faces. Do not repair it. It is load-bearing for Zone 2 below, so read it before you rely on it.

**R4. Clause ② FIRES on this claim.** No `packages/spec/src/**` path is touched, but you are changing what a security pushdown emits or refuses for an input it currently accepts — contract accept/reject behaviour at a permission boundary. Contract review at `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` before the PR is flipped ready. Budget for it.

**R5. No test may be skipped, disabled, quarantined, allow-listed, deleted or re-baselined.**

**R6. Worktree-first, one per repo. ⛔ Never `git stash`** — `refs/stash` is shared across every worktree in this checkout.

---

### Zone 2 — PM MECHANISM ASSUMPTION (measure it; falsification is a good outcome)

**A1 — the convergence hypothesis, and it is the whole card.**

There are two candidate repairs and they are **not** obviously the same change:

- **(a) fail the whole compile closed** with `unresolved-variable`, mirroring what the scalar path does for a null variable — the symmetry the card's title argues for; or
- **(b) strip null members**, mirroring what the two sibling construction paths already do: `engine.ts` (`if (val == null) continue`, `val.filter((id) => id != null)`) and `search-filter.ts` (`if (opt == null) continue`).

They differ on the input that matters: `['u1', null]`. Reading (a) refuses the whole scope; reading (b) compiles `$in: ['u1']` and keeps the resolved member.

**The PM's assumption is that they CONVERGE on safety** — because stripping degrades to fail-closed exactly when the list empties, and R3 establishes that `$in: []` matches nothing consistently on every backend. If that holds, (b) is strictly better: it is safe in the same cases and does not lock a user out of rows their resolved membership legitimately grants.

**MEASURE THIS. Do not assume it.** It is the PM's inference from two facts on the page, not an execution. Specifically: does (b) ever admit a row that (a) would have withheld, on any backend, for any input shape?

**⛔ If they diverge, STOP and report the divergence — do not pick.** Choosing between two security postures for an RLS read scope is a permission-boundary decision and it belongs to the maintainer, not to this seat. A card that comes back with a clean measured divergence and no code is a *successful* outcome here.

**A2 — completeness of the construction set.** The card measured two sibling paths that strip and names `lowerMembership` as "the unguarded member of that set". Verify there is no third unguarded path. The card explicitly did not claim completeness.

---

### Zone 3 — SUGGESTED ROUTE (discard freely)

- The card's positive control — a clean list compiling to a plain `$in`, proving the harness reaches the lowering — belongs in the committed test, so that a future zero reads as a reading and not as a silence. That control is why this card's four probes are trustworthy; keep the property.
- Worth considering whether the guard belongs at `lowerMembership` or one level up at variable resolution, where the scalar rule already lives. The second placement would make the symmetry structural instead of curative — but it is a bigger blast radius, so measure before preferring it.

---

### STOP conditions

- Zone 2 A1 diverges ⇒ report, do not choose.
- The work reaches for `memory-matcher.ts`, `driver-sql`, or `driver-sqlite-wasm` ⇒ you are in #13357's half; report.
- A production context provider that actually injects a null member turns up ⇒ that raises severity and is worth surfacing immediately rather than at PR time. The card was careful to claim only that the lowering does not stop one.

## → `needs-user-decision`:权限边界抉择,PM 不裁

R9 claim A 按 Zone 2 的 STOP 条件返回:**零代码**。这是该条款设计出来要拿到的结果,不是失败。分支 `claude/issue-13496-membership-null-member` 停在派发基 `50cf2940b9`,零 commit、无 PR、无残留。

⛔ **首先记我自己的错:PM 的收敛假设被实测证伪。** 我在派发单里假设 (a) fail-closed 与 (b) strip-null 在安全性上收敛,理由是「strip 在列表清空时正好退化为 fail-closed,而 `$in: []` 已被裁定在所有 backend 匹配零行」。**该推理是极性盲的。**「匹配零行」只在**正极性**下等于 fail-closed。

### 我逐条复核过的实测(在 `df18120502` 上重跑,非转述)

| 断言 | 复核结果 |
|---|---|
| `not in` 是下推子集的一等成员 | ✅ `cel-to-filter.ts` docblock:「`not in` is `!(x in y)`. Negation wraps in `$not`.」并由 `cel-to-filter.test.ts:73` 钉住 |
| `isEmptyMembershipFilter` 极性盲 | ✅ **结构性成立**:它要求内层对象的唯一键是 `$in`;`$not` 包裹后顶层唯一键是 `$not`,内层键是字段名 ⇒ 永远返回 false |
| 该 guard 的存在目的正是防止宽松读法 | ✅ 其自身注释:「fails closed via the deny sentinel rather than an always-false `$in: []`」 |
| SQL 面 `$in:[]` → `1 = 0` | ✅ `read-scope-sql.ts:945` `return FALSE_CLAUSE; // IN () matches nothing — safe`,`FALSE_CLAUSE = '1 = 0'` ⇒ `NOT (1 = 0)` 对每一行为真 |

⇒ **(b) 在负极性下不是退化为 fail-closed,而是退化为 fail-OPEN。** membership 清空时 `!(owner in ids)` 编译成 `$not{$in:[]}`,读作用域**放行整张表**;而 `['u1', null]` 在负极性下会静默**删掉一条黑名单条目**。

### 四棱镜

**① 真实业务需求.** 推动 (b) 的是「用户不该因一个不可解析成员而失去其已解析成员合法授予的行」。但实测:**没有任何一方提供方注入 null 成员** —— `resolve-authz-context.ts:610` 就地 `.filter(v => typeof v === 'string' && v.length > 0)`,spec 声明 `org_user_ids: z.array(z.string())`。所以 (b) 要防的锁死是**未测得的生产场景**;而 (b) 引入的 allow-all,可由今天就能通过 `isPushdownableCel` 授权门的元数据触达。证据是不对称的,指向 A。

**② 长期健全性.** A 是该模块**自己写下的纪律**,且标量情形已被钉住;选 A 使 docblock 从「愿景」变成「事实」。选 (b) 会让下推编译器成为全平台唯一一个安全论证**静默依赖极性**的安全面。

**③ 让 AI 写的代码不易出错.** A 在边界上**大声拒绝**。(b) 是消费端对畸形输入的宽容迁就,而生产端**本来就是对的** —— 在此处容忍这个形状买不到任何东西。
